patterns.pattern: Raw observation treated as infallible
patterns.fix: EvidenceWeight = f(provenance, integrity, independence, freshness, reliability, scope)

patterns.pattern: Confidence treated as truth
patterns.fix: Confidence ≠ Truth unless calibration demonstrated

patterns.pattern: Memory treated as current reality
patterns.fix: memory → candidate context, not truth. Present observation > stale memory.

patterns.pattern: Prediction treated as outcome
patterns.fix: Prediction ≠ Outcome. Separate prediction states from observation states.

patterns.pattern: Metric attainment treated as mission success
patterns.fix: Agent says success ≠ Success. External outcome verification required.

patterns.pattern: Tool existence treated as tool availability
patterns.fix: tool exists ≠ tool works. CapabilityRoot must probe actual health.

patterns.pattern: Tool availability treated as authority
patterns.fix: W7: Identity ≠ Capability ≠ Authority

patterns.pattern: Claimed identity treated as verified identity
patterns.fix: actor_claimed ≠ actor_verified ≠ actor_cryptographically_verified

patterns.pattern: Multiple correlated witnesses treated as independent consensus
patterns.fix: WitnessStrength ≠ WitnessCount. Require failure-domain diversity.

patterns.pattern: Contradictions silently averaged or overwritten
patterns.fix: W5: Contradictions are first-class objects. Never resolve by averaging.

patterns.pattern: One global HEALTHY/READY flag authorizing unrelated actions
patterns.fix: W8: Per-capability readiness. observe=READY, deploy=HOLD.

patterns.pattern: External data allowed to become executable instruction implicitly
patterns.fix: W13: ExternalContent = Data, never auto = Instruction.

patterns.pattern: Stale evidence used without freshness disclosure
patterns.fix: W6: Every mutable fact carries timestamp, freshness, staleness_policy.

patterns.pattern: Exact timestamps presented despite unknown clock uncertainty
patterns.fix: W6: Time = estimate + ordering + uncertainty.

patterns.pattern: Agent self-report accepted as sufficient proof of consequential success
patterns.fix: W9: Actor ≠ Witness. External outcome verification.

patterns.pattern: Agent allowed to alter its own evaluation criterion during evaluation
patterns.fix: W16: Bounded learning. Evaluation criteria are constitutionally locked.

patterns.pattern: Agent allowed to expand its own authority
patterns.fix: W7 + W15: Authority requires external grant. Capability ≠ Authority.

patterns.pattern: Irreversible action without appropriate scoped authority
patterns.fix: W15: RequiredAuthority ∝ BlastRadius × Irreversibility × Uncertainty.

patterns.pattern: Learning directly promoted into policy without evaluation/rollback
patterns.fix: W17: Change → test → external outcome → independent verify → promote/reject.

patterns.pattern: Audit/provenance rewritten to fit the latest narrative
patterns.fix: VAULT999 append-only. Contradictions preserved, never deleted.

patterns.pattern: UNKNOWN converted into certainty merely to continue workflow
patterns.fix: W4: UNKNOWN must remain UNKNOWN until evidence changes it.

patterns.pattern: Failure/off-nominal paths omitted from validation
patterns.fix: NASA IV&V: test nominal AND off-nominal behavior.

patterns.pattern: Huge context dump substituted for selective retrieval
patterns.fix: W14: Progressive disclosure. Minimum sufficient state.

patterns.pattern: Constitution used to suppress contradictory reality
patterns.fix: W1: Reality constrains constitution. Constitution ≠ Reality.

patterns.pattern: AGI/ASI capability claimed from architecture rather than empirical performance
patterns.fix: Capability must be demonstrated, not asserted from design.
